name: Contact At Once
description_en:
Contact At Once is a product in the Live chat category. Its directory profile covers Visitor Targeting, Video Chat, Transfers, Shortcut Messages, Persistent Chat, Offline Form, Knowledge Database, Co-Browsing.

Additional listed capabilities include Call Me Option, Agent Scheduling. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $475.00. Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: communicate through live video. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料还列出电话回拨选项、客服排班。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。
